verdict.rationale: Motion publishes its own API reference covering all endpoints, plus cookbooks with full examples, and a probe confirms the documented REST API is live and enforces its X-API-Key auth. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive (for example a try-it console) or that its examples can be run from the docs. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/runnable console in the API reference, runnable code samples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the docs experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The API reference has a complete guide on all our endpoints.
Our cookbooks are a great place to get started for fully fleshed out examples!
the REST API documented at docs.usemotion.com/api-reference is live and enforces its documented X-API-Key auth.
